blastRadius.summary: 47 'VCard'/'vcard' occurrences in src .ts + ~10 gate/test files with 'vcard' in the NAME + Class unit bf440a63 name='VCard'.

ONLY the CLASS-IDENTITY display name renames: bf440a63 model.name 'VCard' -> 'Contact' (uuid-stable). Refs meaning 'the contact domain class' -> Contact; refs meaning 'the .vcf/vCard format' -> stay VCard.
blastRadius.rule: a rename is a DISPLAY-name change, NEVER an identifier change. Anything resolving the CLASS by the literal string 'VCard' (not uuid) must be re-pointed to uuid or flagged BEFORE the flip; format-lens name-refs are exempt.
blastRadius.action: per-ref triage at build: keep format-lens (parse/download/persist/gate), rename class-identity; FLAG any class resolved by name.
